scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html dist/index.html -Force; Copy-Item src dist/src -Recurse -Force; if (Test-Path .openai/hosting.json) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist/.openai | Out-Null; Copy-Item .openai/hosting.json dist/.openai/hosting.json -Force }; Get-ChildItem assets -File -Recurse | Where-Object { (($_.Extension -eq '.webp' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]characters[\\/]processed[\\/]') -or ($_.Extension -eq '.png' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]characters[\\/]')) } | ForEach-Object { $relative=$_.FullName.Substring((Resolve-Path assets).Path.Length).TrimStart('\\/'); $target=Join-Path dist/assets $relative; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $target) | Out-Null; Copy-Item $_.FullName $target -Force }"
